```python
def solve(case):
    threshold = case["threshold"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    
    results = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        loss_without = call["loss_without_call"]
        loss_with = call["loss_with_call"]
        parseable = call["parseable"]
        tokens = call["prediction_tokens"]
        
        loss_reduction = loss_without - loss_with
        per_token_improvement = loss_reduction / tokens if tokens > 0 else 0.0
        relative_reduction = loss_reduction / loss_without if loss_without > 0 else 0.0
        
        effective = parseable and (loss_reduction > threshold)
        
        results.append({
            "call_id": call_id,
            "loss_reduction": loss_reduction,
            "per_token_improvement": per_token_improvement,
            "relative_reduction": relative_reduction,
            "effective": effective
        })
    
    accepted = [r["call_id"] for r in results if r["effective"]]
    
    return {
        "accepted_calls": accepted,
        "call_results": results
    }
```

```python
    calls = case["calls"]

    rejected = []
    call_scores = {}

        loss_without = call["loss_without_call"]
        loss_with = call["loss_with_call"]
        parseable = call["parseable"]
        tokens = call["prediction_tokens"]

        per_token_delta = delta / tokens if tokens > 0 else 0.0

        call_scores[cid] = {
            "delta": delta,
            "per_token_delta": per_token_delta,
            "effective": is_effective
        }
        
        if is_effective:

        else:
            rejected.append(cid)
    
    return {

        "rejected": rejected,

    }
```
